units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:10">Kel. V, 10</cite> <he>תנורו של ע׳</he> the oven of ʿA. (consisting of tiles cemented with sand); <cite ref="Berakhot 19a:15">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 19a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>מהו ע׳ … שהקיפוהו הלכות כעכנא זה</he> (not <he>כעכנאי</he>) why is it called the oven of A.?… It intimates that they encircled it with discussions as the snake (winds itself around an object; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7); <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:1">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>כעכנא זו</he>.
